title: Provenance
description: A first-class record of how a Measurement result came to exist, carrying the 11 provenance elements of CR-MET-011 section 5 (Q18a). W3C PROV alignment: the Observation is the PROV entity, the collection and calculation steps are PROV activities, and the responsible-party concept carries the accountable party. Reuses dea:Evidence, dea:EvidenceSource, and dea:EvidenceArtifact (CR-5 section 16) rather than duplicating evidence semantics. A Provenance record is 1:1 with the Observation it describes; it is never shared between results.

source_ref.description: Provenance element 1: the original data source (a dea:EvidenceSource). Never a free-text label.

source_record_ref.description: Provenance element 2: the specific originating record or dataset.

collection_activity.description: Provenance element 3: how the information was acquired (a dea:BusinessProcess or a described extraction step). The W3C PROV activity.

calculation_activity.description: Provenance element 4: how the result was derived (the dea:Measurement that executed the formula). The W3C PROV activity.

transformation_chain.description: Provenance element 5: the ordered processing and conversion steps applied between collection and calculation.

responsible_party_ref.description: Provenance element 6: the party accountable for the result (a dea:Actor). The W3C PROV responsible-party concept. Covers person, system, or automated process.

configuration_ref.description: Provenance element 7: the measurement configuration in effect when the result was produced.

formula_version_ref.description: Provenance element 8: the exact calculation definition applied, including the version. A result MUST NOT be attributed to a formula without its version.

metric_version_ref.description: Provenance element 9: the exact Metric definition applied, including the version. This is the binding record for historical reconstruction: the meaning of a historical result is the meaning the Metric had at the version recorded here.

evidence_refs.description: Provenance element 10: supporting source material (dea:Evidence / dea:EvidenceArtifact).

timestamps.description: Provenance element 11: the relevant temporal information. The 7 CR-MET-011 temporal dimensions MUST NOT be collapsed into one timestamp (Q17).

observed_at.description: Observation time: when the value was observed.

measured_at.description: Measurement time: when the measurement was performed. Distinct from observed_at.

recorded_at.description: Transaction time: when the information was recorded in the system.

published_at.description: Publication time: when the result became available to consumers.

effective_from.description: Effective time: when the definition or configuration became applicable.

effective_to.description: Effective time: when the definition or configuration ceased to apply.

reporting_period_ref.description: Reference to the dea:ReportingPeriod the result represents.

valid_from.description: Valid time: from when the result applies.

valid_to.description: Valid time: until when the result applies.

reproducibility.description: CR-MET-011 section 6: the declared reproducibility posture of the recorded result.

reproducible.description: Whether the result can be reproduced from the recorded provenance without recalculation.

retention_class.description: The retention obligation governing the source material required for reproduction.
